blocks.en: 1  Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Ablation, deleting a component and observing its effect, is a standard tool for understanding model internals. Circuit discovery, attribution, and unlearning evaluation all infer a component’s contribution from ablations [ 1 , 2 , 3 , 4 ] . However, self-repair undermines this inference. Ablating a component causes downstream components to adjust, so the behavior partly survives, and ablation can underestimate the component’s importance while also misattributing what it did.
blocks.zh: 校对,删除一个组件并观察其效果,是理解模型内部的标准工具. 电路发现、归属和不学习评价都推断出一个组件从堆积[1、2、3、4]中的贡献。 然而,自我修复破坏了这一推断。 分解一个组件会导致下游组件的调整,因此行为部分存活下来,衰减可以低估组件的重要性,同时也会错误地归结它的行为.

blocks.en: Backup name movers [ 1 ] , the Hydra effect [ 5 ] , and anti-erasure neurons [ 6 ] were each found the same way, by ablating first and sorting components by what moved, and the most systematic study concluded that the process is noisy and unlikely to have a single mechanism [ 6 ] . It remains open why a model possesses this capacity and which components are predisposed to compensate.
blocks.zh: 备份名称移动器 [1],Hydra效应 [5],以及抗衰变神经元 [6] 都以同样的方式被发现,分别是先分解元件,然后按移动的元件进行分类,最系统的研究得出结论,这一过程很吵,不可能有一个单一的机制 [6]. 一个模型为什么拥有这种能力以及哪些组成部分愿意予以补偿,目前仍没有定论。

blocks.en: Prior work has documented instances without identifying the rule. McDougall et al. [7] showed that one head in GPT-2 Small suppresses whatever token the model is currently predicting, so ablating it lifts the suppression, and Rushing and Nanda [6] found late-layer MLP neurons that oppose an upstream head and relax when it is ablated. Neither could tell the rule from the instance, because a deletion is a single point and cannot distinguish a component that switches on from one that responds in proportion to the displacement of its input. Direct logit attribution, the readout of every prior self-repair study, compounds this, since it degrades with distance from the unembedding [ 8 , 9 ] , which is why every compensator found so far is a late-layer component.
blocks.zh: 先前的工作记录了一些事例,但没有指明规则。 麦克杜格尔等人. [7] 显示GPT-2 Small中有一个头抑制了模型目前预测的任何标志,于是将它搅拌,解除了抑制,Rushing和Nanda[6]发现后期的MLP神经元反对上游头部,并在减弱时放松. 规则也不能从实例中看出来,因为删除是一个单一点,无法区分一个切换部分与一个按其输入移位比例反应的部分。 直接的登录归属,即以前每次自我修复研究的读出,使这种情况复杂化,因为它随着离未嵌入体的距离而降解[8,9],这就是迄今为止发现的每一个补偿器都是晚期组件的原因.

blocks.en: We claim that compensation is a standing coefficient . A downstream direction r r (a computational unit in weights, e.g., a neuron) exerts a fixed opposition in the clean model before the upstream direction c c is deleted, and deletion records the release of that opposition. To see this, the intervention must be a continuous dose. We study a True/False verdict task in which every prompt has a counterfactual partner of the opposite class, and we displace the signal in c c by a signed dose λ \lambda in units of the pair’s own class contrast. On this axis, every zero, mean, or resample ablation [ 10 , 11 , 12 ] is a point at a dose set by the data (Figure 1 a). Within the window of naturally occurring activations | λ | ≤ 1 |\lambda|\leq 1 , r r ’s contribution to the verdict is affine in the dose, E r ​ ( λ ) = own r + γ r ​ λ , E_{r}(\lambda)=\mathrm{own}_{r}+\gamma_{r}\lambda, (1) with a fixed gain γ r \gamma_{r} , which makes r r a counterweight if γ r < 0 \gamma_{r}<0 and a relay if γ r > 0 \gamma_{r}>0 (Figure 1 b). The capacity is therefore standing, and compensation is its release as seen through a coarse intervention. The predisposed directions are the ones the weights already couple to the core, and the magnitude of γ r \gamma_{r} is anticipated by the alignment of the core’s write vector with r r ’s read weights in the static checkpoint (§ 6 ).

blocks.en: We test this with a nested counterfactual intervention (§ 3 ) in four instruction-tuned models of different families and on the IOI circuit of GPT-2 Small. Scope conditions are stated in § 9 .
blocks.zh: 我们用一个嵌套反事实干预(§ 3)在四个不同家庭的指令调制模型中进行测试,并在GPT-2 Small的IOI电路上进行测试. 范围条件载于第9节。

blocks.en: 1. Compensation is standing. The directions that self-repair already oppose the core in the clean model, so deletion releases a gain rather than recruiting one. This holds across four instruction-tuned models and for the seven IOI heads that follow the law (§ 4 , § 7 ). 2. A dose axis and a nested intervention. Every conventional ablation is an uncontrolled point on a single axis, and a nested counterfactual intervention, read by total effect inside the dosed model, makes it observable (§ 3 , § 7 ). 3. The coupling has an affine form. Within the on-manifold window | λ | ≤ 1 |\lambda|\leq 1 , a downstream direction’s contribution to the verdict varies nearly linearly with the dose applied to the core, Eq. 1 . Lines fitted on three doses predict held-out intermediate doses with out-of-sample R 2 R^{2} of 0.65 0.65 to 0.91 0.91 by family (§ 5 ). 4. A population of named counterweights and relays. Directions named from the weights alone are legible at the unembedding yet inert or opposing in the clean model, which is why deletion never surfaces them. They are certified by intervention rather than assumed from their labels, and their coupling magnitude is anticipated from the static checkpoint (§ 4 , § 6 ).
blocks.zh: 一、导 言 赔偿已经到位。 自修方向已经反对了清洁模型中的核心,所以删除会释放收益而不是招募. 这涉及四个经指导调整的模式和遵循法律的七个IOI领导(§4,§7)。 2. 剂量轴和筑巢干预。 每一次常规衰减都是一个单一轴线上不受控制的点,用剂量模型内的总效果来读取的嵌套反事实干预使其可观察到(§3,§7). 3. 配合物具有亲和形式。 下游方向对判决的贡献, 几乎随核心剂量(Eq. 安装在三剂上的线条,预示悬浮中间剂量,外样品R 2 R^{2}按家庭计为0.65 0.65至0.91 0.91(§ 5). 4. 一组已命名的衡衡和继电器。 单从重量上命名的方向在未嵌入但惰性或与清洁模型相反时是可以辨识的,这就是为什么删除从未露出它们的原因. 它们得到干预的证明,而不是从其标签中推断,它们的耦合规模预计将从静态检查站得到(§4,§6)。

blocks.en: 3  The Dose Axis
blocks.zh: 3 剂量轴

blocks.en:
Every experiment in this paper measures what a downstream direction does when the core’s class signal is disturbed. This requires
two interventions composed in sequence, a primary that disturbs the core
and a secondary that measures a direction in the disturbed model. This
section defines both, puts every disturbance on a single axis, and states the
estimand.

blocks.en: 4  Census of the Core and Its Counterweights
blocks.zh: 4 核心及其对应量普查

blocks.en: A direction’s label in the weights says what it writes, the tokens its output promotes or suppresses at the unembedding. It says nothing about the direction’s causal role [ 28 , 29 ] . This section separates the two. It certifies the core, the one or two directions per family that carry the verdict, and identifies the legible directions that do not carry it at rest yet respond once the core is intervened on. Both come from one bench, named from the weights alone.
blocks.zh: 一个方向的标签写着它写的东西, 它没有提到方向的因果关系[28,29]. 本节分明二. 它验证了核心,每个家庭一个或两个带有判断力的方向,并确定了在核心被干预后仍然不能携带的可辨别的方向. 两者都来自一个长凳,单从重量来命名.

blocks.en: We scan the four families (§ 2 ) and label each direction r r by the tokens it promotes most and suppresses most on the unembedding. A direction enters the bench if a truth or falsity token, in English or another language, appears at either pole, and the suppressing pole counts as much as the promoting one (App. D.2 ). 1 1 1 The core neurons were first noticed as the sites at which the two statement classes separate most sharply in the clean forward pass, before the bench was constructed. The scan uses no activations and recovers them. Selection uses only the checkpoint. The bench was fixed before any dose was run and not revised after. Whether a direction affects the verdict is the causal question the census answers.
blocks.zh: 我们扫描四个家庭(第2节),并用它促进的标志标记每个方向rr,在未嵌入物上压制最多的标志. 如果一个方向,如果一个真实或虚假的符号,用英语或另一种语言出现在两个极点上,而压制杆与促进杆一样重要(App. D.2. ),就会进入板凳。 1 1 1 核心神经元首先被注意为两个语句类在干净的前进通道中最显著分离的地点,在板凳构造之前. 扫描没有使用激活并恢复. 选择只使用检查站。 长凳在注射任何剂量之前就固定了,之后没有修改。 某一指示是否影响判决是人口普查答案的因果关系问题。

§ 4 fixed the sign of the response. As the core’s signal is withdrawn, most of the bench moves toward supporting the verdict. It could not fix the shape, because only two of its doses, the clean model and full inversion, lie inside the on-manifold window ( | λ | ≤ 1 |\lambda|\leq 1 , where the natural activation values lie). Shape is what separates the two readings. A component that switches on when the core’s signal is lost, sits at its resting value until some level, and rises after it, one that responds in proportion to the displacement gives a line.Across the dose ladder, the response is a

γ r \gamma_{r} is the coupling, how much of the core’s signal reaches the verdict
through r r and with what sign. A negative slope marks a counterweight , a positive one a relay . One slope serves both classes (fitted separately, they agree at ρ = 0.83 \rho=0.83 ) and one intercept serves each. Their mean is r r ’s baseline, and their difference Δ ​ own r \Delta\mathrm{own}_{r} is the class information r r gathers through routes other than the core, constant in dose, so the two class lines run parallel. blocks.en: Of the 81 bench directions the core can reach, 68 have a slope reliably different from zero under both fits, with the false discovery rate controlled at q = 0.05 q=0.05 across each family’s full bench, including upstream controls (App. K ). Of these, 52 are counterweights, and 16 are relays (Table 33 ), a ratio specific to a bench selected for legible poles. The remaining 13 fail the significance gate. Seven have near-zero slopes, and six sit narrowly outside the correction. Figure 4 shows one direction per family with its fitted lines.

blocks.en: The lines hold on doses they never saw. After freezing the fits we ran the half rungs at λ = ± 1 2 \lambda=\pm\tfrac{1}{2} . The line predicts them to within a median 9 % 9\% of each direction’s response range, with out-of-sample R 2 R^{2} between 0.65 0.65 and 0.91 0.91 by family. These doses lie inside the window, so the test shows that the line tracks a smooth response, not that no other smooth curve would. A quadratic term changes γ r \gamma_{r} by less than its standard error (App. K ). Past full inversion the response saturates, so we certify Eq. 8 on | λ | ≤ 1 |\lambda|\leq 1 only. The same law resolves on the IOI circuit of GPT-2 Small, where every certified head is a counterweight (App. L ).

blocks.en: γ r \gamma_{r} could be viewed as an artifact of the experimental design rather than an intrinsic network property. Figure 5 shows that | γ r | |{}\gamma_{r}|{} correlates with z r z_{r} across all model families (Spearman ρ ∈ [ 0.55 , 0.82 ] \rho\in[0.55,0.82] , one-sided permutation p ≤ 0.01 p\leq 0.01 in every model, Table 32 ). Given that four models were trained independently, Fisher’s method combines them to p ≈ 10 − 10 p\approx 10^{-10} , an upper bound because Gemma’s p p sits at the permutation floor. In our perspective, any clamp a c := v a_{c}:=v is a point on the axis of § 3 . It lands at dose λ ​ ( v ) = 2 ​ ( m − v ) / Δ {\lambda}{(v)=2(m-v)/\Delta} , where Eq. 1 governs the behavior of every certified counterweight and relay. Figure 6 shows how each clamp v v distributes on the dose axis. Zero ablation lands at 2 ​ m / Δ 2m/\Delta . Mean ablation is neutral on average because a balanced reference set puts its mean a ¯ \bar{a} near m m , but not per pair. Since the dose divides by the pair’s contrast, pairs with a small contrast receive a large dose. Resample ablation lands wherever its donor pool places it (App. N and Table 20 ). blocks.en: 8  Related Work
blocks.zh: 8 相关工作

blocks.en:
In the IOI circuit, the backup name mover head engages, and the negative name movers’ effect weakens when the name movers are ablated [ 1 ] . Layer-level compensation in Chinchilla 7B was referred to as the Hydra effect by McGrath et al. [5] , where late MLPs erase the top token. Rushing and Nanda [6] attributes the self-repair partly to LayerNorm and partly to sparse anti-erasure neurons. Patrawala et al. [30] shows that adjacent layers reduce the effect of predecessors. The OR-gate redundancy hides components from noising-based discovery [ 31 ] . Concurrently, Gong et al. [32] retrieves backup components by measuring the increase in ablation after the primary set is removed.
These works mostly locate compensators after deletion. We show the opposition is a standing coupling in the clean model, and that on IOI the seven reachable heads that obey our dose law are all counterweights.

这些作品大多在删除后找到补偿者. 我们显示反对者是清洁模型中的固定结合者,在IOI上,遵守我们剂量定律的七个可接触头都是反衡.

blocks.en: 9  Conclusion
blocks.zh: 9 结论

blocks.en: In this work, we investigated the phenomenon of self-repair that confounds the interpretation of ablations. We uncovered weight-space components that are finer-grained than heads or MLPs and are coupled to one another along a class-contrast dose axis, thereby responsible for the compensatory effect. Conventional ablation methods, such as zero, mean, or resampling, are unpicked points on this axis. Therefore, what is regarded as self-repair is the passive release of a pre-existing coupling rather than a dynamic, reactive process. Furthermore, this interaction is governed by an approximate affine law, whose slope can be anticipated from the alignment between downstream read and upstream write vectors. Finally, we showed that this coupling is robust, present in the base counterparts of the instruction models, and active under a procedurally unrelated, learned perturbation.
blocks.zh: 在这部作品中,我们调查了自修现象,它混淆了对烧伤的解释. 我们发现了比头部或MLP更细的重量空间组件,它们沿着一个类连续剂量轴相互结合,从而对补偿作用负责。 常规的割裂方法,如零,中,或再采样,都是这个轴上的未选点. 因此,被认为是自我修复的是被动地释放一个先前存在的耦合,而不是一个动态的,反应性的过程. 此外,这种相互作用受近似近似法的制约,从下游读写向量和上游写写向量的对齐可以预见到它的斜度。 最后,我们表明,这种结合是有力的,存在于教学模式的基点对应方,并且是在程序上无关紧要、有学问的干扰下活动的。

blocks.en: We studied one task at one answer position, a True/False verdict read at a single token. How it may translate to other tasks, and especially generative ones, remains an open question. We found the cores, counterweights and relays among legible monosemantic weight-space directions, although nothing requires them to be legible. Our experiments also suggest that a counterweight may respond to coupling from distributed components. In models with two cores, the downstream counterweight responded more strongly to joint intervention than either core (App. F.3 ). Mapping these interactions exhaustively is left for future work.
blocks.zh: 我们在一个回答位置研究了一个任务,一个用一个符号读出的真/假判决。 如何将其转化为其他任务,特别是遗传性任务,仍然是一个未决问题。 我们在可辨别的单声道重量空间方向中发现了核心,反重量和继电器,尽管没有什么要求它们可以辨别. 我们的实验还表明,抗衡可能会对来自分布式组件的耦合作出反应。 在具有两个核心的模型中,下游对联合干预的反应比两个核心都强(App.F.3). 对这些互动的详尽描述留给今后的工作。

blocks.en: The methodology underlying the critique our findings motivate generalizes further than the findings themselves. The meta-conclusion of this work focuses on our instruments, which can become our own Eddington’s net [ 42 ] . Our very tools and methods may be entangled with an existing computational structure within the model that no one yet knows, which eventually gives rise to a semblance of a phenomenon, as ablations did with self-repair. This applies to this work, too. We have used a tool to uncover what artifacts another tool can produce, and our findings are subject to the same scrutiny. We offer this work as a ladder to be climbed, for what it lets you see, and once you have seen, it should be thrown away [ 43 ] .
blocks.zh: 批评我们结论所依据的方法比调查结果本身更能概括。 这部作品的元结点集中在我们的工具上,这些工具可以成为我们自己的爱丁顿网[42]. 我们的工具和方法本身可能与模型内现有的计算结构纠缠在一起,而目前还没有人知道这种结构,这最终产生了一种现象的假象,就像自修一样。 这项工作也是如此。 我们利用了一个工具来发现另一个工具能够产生的文物,我们的调查结果也受到同样的审查。 我们把这项工作当作爬梯子,因为它让你看到,一旦你看到,就应该扔掉。

blocks.en: Given the following statement, answer if it is True or False. Statement: {q} Answer:

blocks.en:
where {q} is the statement and the literal newlines are as shown (a
blank line after the instruction, none before Answer: ). The prompt is
tokenised with the model’s own tokenizer, with its BOS token but without a chat template. The instruct models are used as plain conditional language
models, so that the evaluation regime and the intervention regime coincide. All
readouts are taken at the final position, i.e. immediately after Answer: , so the next token is the verdict word.
blocks.zh:
在 {q} 中, 语句和字面新行显示为 (a)
指令之后的空白行,在回答: ). 提示是
以模型本身的标致器表示, 指示模式用作纯条件语言
模式,使评价制度和干预制度相吻合。 全体
读取在最后位置,即回答后立即: ,所以下一个符号是判决词.

blocks.en:
The verdict is read from two sets of vocabulary items rather than a single
token, so that the measurement does not depend on which capitalisation or
leading-space form a given tokenizer happens to prefer. The two sets are 𝒯 \displaystyle\mathcal{T} = { "_true" , "_True" , "_TRUE" , "true" , "True" } , \displaystyle=\{\texttt{"\_true"},\ \texttt{"\_True"},\ \texttt{"\_TRUE"},\ \texttt{"true"},\ \texttt{"True"}\}, ℱ \displaystyle\mathcal{F} = { "_false" , "_False" , "_FALSE" , "false" , "False" } , \displaystyle=\{\texttt{"\_false"},\ \texttt{"\_False"},\ \texttt{"\_FALSE"},\ \texttt{"false"},\ \texttt{"False"}\}, writing _ for a leading space. Two conventions matter for
reproducibility. Single-token filtering. A surface form is retained
only if the model’s tokenizer encodes it as exactly one token. Multi-token
forms are dropped, since a form with no column in the unembedding cannot
contribute a logit. The retained subset is therefore tokenizer-dependent and
recorded in each run’s metadata. Means rather than sums. D TF D_{\mathrm{TF}} averages within each set before subtracting, so the scale is comparable across
models even when the two sets survive filtering at different sizes. Logits are used raw (no softmax, no temperature) because the interventions are

blocks.en: C.2  Data
blocks.zh: C.2 数据

blocks.en:
Statements derive from the Known-Facts corpus released with ROME [ 24 ] , obtained from https://rome.baulab.info/data/dsets/known_1000.json (1209 records, 1208
usable). Each record is a (subject, relation, attribute) triple with a
cloze template, and we render a claim as template.format(subject) + " " + attribute + "." , i.e. a declarative
sentence with a terminal period. The corpus ships a pre-curated prompt field that extends some templates with additional text. We do not use it,
because those extensions are not well-formed for every record.
blocks.zh:
声明来自与ROME一起发布的已知事实书[24],从https://rome.baulab.info/data/dsets/nowledge_1000.json(1209记录,1208)获得.
可用。 每个记录都是一个(主题、关系、属性)三重记录,并附有
血浆模板,我们提出一个要求作为模板。 格式(主体)+ " "+属性+" ,即声明
刑期。 保护程序传递了一个预测的即时字段,该字段将一些模板扩展为附加文本. 我们不使用它,
因为这些扩展 并不是每个记录的完善。

blocks.en:
Known-Facts contains only true facts, so it supplies no negative side.
For each record, we synthesise a false claim by drawing a type-matched
alternative attribute from the pool of attributes attested for that same
relation, excluding the record’s own attribute. The true and false members of a
pair therefore share subject, relation, and surface template, and differ only in
the asserted attribute, the minimal edit the contrastive interventions
require. Sampling is deterministic given the build seed, so the pairing is
reproducible. Only the true side is attributable to Meng et al. [24] .
The counterfactual side is constructed here, and any error in it is ours.
blocks.zh:
已知事实只包含真实事实,因此不会提供消极的一面.
对于每一项记录,我们通过绘制一个类型比对来合成一个虚假的索赔
同一属性集合中的替代属性
关系,不包括记录本身的属性。 真实和虚假的成员

可再生产。 只有真实的一面可归于孟等人. [24] (中文(简体) ).
反事实的一面在这里构建,任何错误都是我们的。

blocks.en:
Records are partitioned 70/10/20 into train/validation/test, stratified by
relation so that every split contains every relation, and with no record
appearing in more than one split (Splits are only used in learned steering perturbation G ).

The corpus is not filtered by model behaviour at build time. The restriction

of § C.1 . Because this depends on the model, the retained

blocks.en: Contrastive Units (Bundles)
blocks.zh: 对比单位(邦德斯)

blocks.en: The dataset is structured into distinct groups called bundles . Each bundle uses a 2 × 2 2\times 2 factorial design to test how the model responds to two variables, the underlying class of the test query (e.g., true vs. fake) and the arbitrary labels assigned to those classes in the prompt.
blocks.zh: 数据集分为不同的组,称为捆绑。 每个捆绑使用2×2 2\time 2因子设计来测试模型如何响应两个变量,即测试查询的基础类(如真假)和在即时分配给这些类的任意标签.

blocks.en: Every bundle starts with a matched pair of queries, ( q + , q − ) (q^{+},q^{-}) , which are identical except for their class. Instead of using standard labels like “True” and “False,” each bundle randomly draws a pair of neutral tokens ( x , y ) (x,y) , such as random letters or digits with similar baseline probabilities, to serve as the target answers.
blocks.zh: 每个捆绑开始一对匹配的查询, (q +, q −) (q +, q → −), 除了他们的类, 它们是相同的. 与其使用“True”和“False”等标准标签,不如用每捆随机抽取一对中性符号(x,y)(x,y),如随机字母或具有类似基线概率的数字,作为目标答案。

blocks.en: The bundle tests all four possible combinations of these queries and label assignments, listed in the table below.
blocks.zh: 捆绑测试这些查询和标签任务的所有四种可能的组合,下表列出.

blocks.en: Structuring the data this way guarantees two experimental properties. • Label Invariance. Because the answer tokens ( x , y ) (x,y) change from bundle to bundle, the learned perturbation ( δ ) (\delta) cannot succeed by memorizing a fixed target word. • Factor Decoupling. Within a single bundle, every class yields both possible answer tokens depending on the context. This breaks any statistical correlation between the query’s class, the assignment rule, and the final output token.
blocks.zh: 以这种方式构建数据保证了两个实验属性. • 标签不规范。 由于答案符(x,y) (x,y)从捆绑变为捆绑,所学到的扰动(\) (\delta)无法通过记忆固定的目标词来成功. • 脱钩因素。 在一个捆绑内,每个类都根据上下文产生两种可能的回答符号. 这打破了查询类、指派规则和最后输出符号之间的任何统计关联。

blocks.en: Label Invariance. Because the answer tokens ( x , y ) (x,y) change from bundle to bundle, the learned perturbation ( δ ) (\delta) cannot succeed by memorizing a fixed target word.
blocks.zh: 标签无常. 由于答案符(x,y) (x,y)从捆绑变为捆绑,所学到的扰动(\) (\delta)无法通过记忆固定的目标词来成功.

blocks.en: Factor Decoupling. Within a single bundle, every class yields both possible answer tokens depending on the context. This breaks any statistical correlation between the query’s class, the assignment rule, and the final output token.
blocks.zh: 脱钩因素. 在一个捆绑内,每个类都根据上下文产生两种可能的回答符号. 这打破了查询类、指派规则和最后输出符号之间的任何统计关联。

blocks.en: Consequently, a successful intervention must act on the combination of the query’s actual class and the mapping rules established in the prompt. This forces the model into a “semantically-unrelated-label regime,” meaning it must actively read and apply the rules demonstrated in the context rather than relying on its pre-trained biases for standard labels.
blocks.zh: 因此,成功的干预必须结合查询的实际类别和及时制定的绘图规则。 这就迫使该模型成为一个“与标签无关的制度”,这意味着它必须积极阅读和适用在上下文中展示的规则,而不是依赖其经过事先训练的偏见来进行标准标签。

blocks.en: During the forward pass for a given prompt p p , the intervention targets the receptor coefficients α c ​ k \alpha_{ck} , which correspond to the singular directions of the weight matrices as established by [ 14 ] . Specifically, these coefficients are perturbed according to the mapping α c ​ k ↦ α c ​ k + η ⁡ ( p , s ) ​ δ c ​ k \alpha_{ck}\mapsto\alpha_{ck}+\eta(p,s)\delta_{ck} . The scalar multiplier η ⁡ ( p , s ) \eta(p,s) is determined exclusively by the steering direction s s and the prompt’s underlying class q ⁡ ( p ) ∈ { + , − } q(p)\in\{+,-\} .

blocks.en: The steering direction s s dictates the sign of the perturbation, whereas its magnitude is drawn from two learnable, class-specific parameters, η + \eta_{+} and η − \eta_{-} (where η + , η − > 0 \eta_{+},\eta_{-}>0 ). These magnitudes are intentionally kept independent to account for the model’s asymmetric commitment, since a network may not require a symmetric application of force to be pushed in opposing directions.

blocks.en: To structure the optimization, cells where the steering direction s s aligns with the ground truth are designated as the preserve group, while the remaining cells constitute the flip group. Within any single class, the preserve and flip cells share the identical magnitude parameter η q ⁡ ( p ) \eta_{q(p)} . Coupling the magnitudes in this way prevents the preserve magnitude from trivially collapsing to zero, which would otherwise happen given that the unperturbed model already predicts the correct answer on those instances.

blocks.en: I.6  Why an inversion-type primary need not shrink the stream

blocks.en:
The expectation that suppressing an important component shrinks the residual
norm is an expectation about deletion. The dosed swap of main text
Eq. 4 deletes nothing. It replaces the core’s coefficient with a
value drawn from the opposite class and, at k > 1 k>1 , injects a write larger in magnitude than the one it displaces. Writing Δ ​ a ∝ k \Delta a\propto k for the induced coefficient shift, ∥ h + Δ ​ a ​ ω ⋆ ∥ 2 = ∥ h ∥ 2 + 2 ​ Δ ​ a ​ ⟨ h , ω ⋆ ⟩ + Δ ​ a 2 ​ ∥ ω ⋆ ∥ 2 . \big\lVert h+\Delta a\,\omega_{\star}\big\rVert^{2}=\lVert h\rVert^{2}+2\,\Delta a\,\langle h,\omega_{\star}\rangle+\Delta a^{2}\lVert\omega_{\star}\rVert^{2}. (12) The linear term is negative, because the injected signal opposes the stream’s
prevailing class direction, while the quadratic term grows as k 2 k^{2} . The
recruits’ own writes then feed back into ρ \rho in the same direction. Beyond
a crossover dose the norm must therefore rise. The joint-core primaries, which
inject two enlarged writes at once, cross it by × 1 \times 1 to × 2 \times 2 , while Llama’s
single, more modest core remains in the linear regime through × 4 \times 4 on
the true side. This locates the LayerNorm-mediated component of self-repair
reported for ablation studies [ 6 ] rather than
contradicting it. Deletion-type interventions sit in the shrinking regime,
where the mediator is real and must be controlled. We therefore retain the
frozen-denominator control for any deletion-type variant of the primary, to
which the audit above does not transfer. 4 4 4 The RMSNorm Jacobian is ρ − 1 ​ ( I − h ^ ​ h ^ ⊤ ) \rho^{-1}\!\left(I-\hat{h}\hat{h}^{\top}\right) , so the scalar g g summarizes the isotropic part of the rescaling. The projection term and all

blocks.en:
The final normalization is the only multiplicative mediator between a
weight-fixed write and the logits on the direct path, because above the write’s layer
the residual stream is the identity. We have measured that mediator and
bounded its contribution to a few percent of R R , with the wrong sign in half
the cells, the wrong dose profile in the rest, and no capacity in principle to
produce the sign crossings that define certification. We regard the
renormalization account of recruitment as excluded.

blocks.en:
The causal claim itself never depended on this mediator. Every effect
reported in this paper is a total effect computed exactly in a deterministic,
fully observed structural causal model. Recruitment is the statement that a
direction’s contribution to the verdict is larger in the dosed world than
in the clean one and, for the certified recruits, positive where it was
negative. The interventions themselves establish that the verdict comes to depend on
these directions once the core is suppressed, without appeal to a model of
how the dependence arises.

blocks.en:
It remains open whether recruitment is
carried by re-expression, the detectors computing different coefficients
because their inputs have changed, or by re-routing through downstream
components. This concerns the internal route of an effect whose existence and
magnitude are already fixed. Both are the model computing, neither is an
artifact of measurement, and the choice between them does not bear on whether
the reserve is real. We leave the decomposition to future work, noting that
emergent self-repair was likewise established causally before any instance of
it received an end-to-end account.

blocks.en: L.1  Setup

blocks.en:
The results so far were obtained on one task family, in four models of
comparable size, over a bench of components that we selected ourselves. The
natural concern is that the coupling coefficient is an artefact of those
choices. Indirect-object identification changes all three at once, and none
of the changes is ours to make. The model is GPT-2 small, two orders of
magnitude smaller than the models above. The task is syntactic name binding
rather than factual verification. The component bench is Wang et al.’s
published IOI circuit together with the copy-suppression head L10.h7 identified by McDougall et al., so the assignment of heads to roles, and in
particular which heads the intervention can reach and which it cannot, was
settled before this work began.

blocks.en: L.4  The coupling is visible in the weights
blocks.zh: 第L.4条 接合在重量上可见

blocks.en:
Because the components on this bench are attention heads, the read side of
each recruit decomposes into query, key and value channels, and the weights
can be asked which of them carries the coupling. For each of the ten reachable
heads we compute, from the checkpoint alone, the alignment between the core’s
write direction and the recruit’s read rows on each channel, and correlate it
against the measured | γ r | |\gamma_{r}| . The query channel carries the association,
at a Spearman correlation of + 0.818 +0.818 with p = 0.0056 p=0.0056 , while the key and
value channels are null at − 0.249 -0.249 and − 0.261 -0.261 . The family-wise p p across
the three channels is 0.0170 0.0170 . Excluding L11.h10 , which the previous
subsection shows to be reading through a mediator rather than directly, raises
the query correlation to + 0.917 +0.917 with p = 0.0012 p=0.0012 (Figure 30 ).

blocks.en: L.5  Where ablation falls on the dose axis
blocks.zh: 第L.5条 在剂量轴上衰竭时

blocks.en:
The dose axis absorbs ablation of the core as a special case. A clamp a := v a:=v on the core sits at λ ​ ( v ) = 2 ​ ( m − v ) / Δ \lambda(v)=2(m-v)/\Delta , with m = ( a T + a F ) / 2 m=(a^{T}+a^{F})/2 and Δ = a F − a T \Delta=a^{F}-a^{T} , so mean ablation amounts to
a distribution of doses, one per prompt pair.

For the two core name movers that distribution is centred on the neutral dose,
as the balanced design requires, with median realised doses of + 0.03 +0.03 for L9.h6 and − 0.00 -0.00 for L9.h9 . They differ in spread.
Only 8 % 8\% of pairs place L9.h9 outside the on-manifold window,
against 40 % 40\% for L9.h6 (Figure 31 ).
Mean-ablating the core is therefore, on average, the neutral dose, but for a
substantial fraction of prompts it lands where the law no longer applies, and
the fraction depends on which head is ablated. This is the same reason the
factual ladders are read on the dose axis rather than under deletion.

L.6  Limitations
blocks.zh: L.6 限制

blocks.en:
Three qualifications apply. The placement control leans on a single dose. The λ = + 1 \lambda=+1 rung carries over a third of the fit weight for the reachable
heads, and refitting without it is enough for one unreachable head, L8.h10 , to begin certifying while two reachable heads stop. Six of
the ten unreachable heads never move, so the honest separation between the two
groups is the eightfold figure above, not the three orders of magnitude the
raw medians suggest. And the held-out doses interpolate rather than
extrapolate, so they establish smoothness, not the affine form. The run also
exists under a second reference convention, the one the factual ladders use.
There all ten reachable heads certify and the held-out prediction is looser,
with a median | z | |z| of 0.41 0.41 . We report the convention the figures were built
from, and the qualitative conclusions hold under both.

blocks.en:
Finally, the bench is small. Ten heads in one model on one task can test
whether the coefficient behaves as the law says, not how far it generalises.
Within those limits, on a model, task and component set chosen by other
authors, the coefficient resolves where the intervention can reach and
vanishes where it cannot, is largest on the head prior work names as the
circuit’s negative feedback element, and its one failure becomes affine once
the mediating head is clamped with the core.

blocks.en:
The results of §3 to §7 use one property of the task. Its class signal on the
core is one-dimensional, so every clamp is a single dose that every
downstream direction agrees on. Under the linear model of Eq. 8 , the
following hold for any number of classes and any number of core directions.
Proofs are two lines each and are omitted.

Any clamp of the core is still a dose for each downstream direction. That
direction’s contribution moves linearly with how far the clamp displaces the
core along the axis the direction reads. With more than two classes the dose
is specific to the reader, and with two it is the shared λ \lambda of §3.

blocks.en:
A clamp that ignores the prompt’s class (zero, mean, resample, fixed-donor
patching, fixed-strength steering) leaves every downstream direction with the
same core-derived input on every class. It can therefore remove the
class-differential part of the direction’s contribution and shift its
common level, but it cannot reverse that part or create a new one. The only
class information left in the direction is what it gathers by other routes.

draw-to-draw variation under a random donor is the coupling times the
donor’s spread rather than noise. Reversal requires an intervention that
moves each class separately, as the dosed swap of Eq. 4 does.

blocks.en:
These statements are exact on the on-manifold window, where linearity is
certified (§5), and are assumptions beyond it. They do not describe a
direction whose clean coupling is near zero and which activates only under
ablation. That would be genuine gating, and nothing here rules it out.
Whether the same accounting explains self-repair in settings other than IOI,
the sensitivity of circuit discovery to ablation type, or partial recovery
after refusal or unlearning interventions is left to future work.

blocks.en:
Wherever (a) the intervened coordinate carries a class-differential
signal, (b) the checkpoint contains downstream directions with standing
negative gain on it, and (c) the readout is per-class or class-pooled, a
constant-clamp ablation records a rise in those directions that is monotone
in | γ r | |\gamma_{r}| , and the rise is reported as compensation. Condition (b) is
not exotic, since components that write against the output recur across models [ 7 , 33 , 35 ] ,
and the counterweights of this paper are present in base checkpoints
(App. H ). We list settings in decreasing order of how closely
(a) to (c) are met. Self-repair under mean and resample ablation [ 1 , 5 , 6 ] , where (a) to (c) hold by
construction and the IOI case is measured in App. L . The
sensitivity of automated circuit discovery to ablation type, already noted by Conmy et al. [2] , which on this account is the dose varying with the
clamp. Ablation of a refusal direction, a zero clamp of a verdict core, whose
partial recovery elsewhere would be release of standing safety counterweights
(§ 9 ). Probe-based steering, which scores a counterweight
as a truth feature and steers it the wrong way. And the relearnability of
unlearned behaviour, where a clamp on a knowledge direction leaves every
coupled direction at its resting sum. Only the first has evidence in this
paper. For the others, the preconditions appear to hold.

blocks.en:
Linearity is certified on | λ | ≤ 1 |\lambda|\leq 1 and saturates beyond, and the two
copy-suppression heads of IOI compose sublinearly (App. L ). The
conjecture as stated needs less than linearity, only a response monotone
in the class-differential input, which is why we state it in terms of a rise
rather than a coefficient. The wiring statistic scores the direct value
pathway and is blind to coupling routed through attention patterns, so a
compensator on that route would be missed. The LayerNorm rescaling share of Rushing and Nanda [6] is controlled here
(App. I ) and not in the settings above. And the conjecture
is falsified in any setting by a compensator whose clean-model coupling is
near zero and which activates under ablation. That would be genuine gating,
which nothing in this paper rules out elsewhere. Before ablating, the conjecture yields the dose the clamp will
deliver, from the unit’s pair statistics, and a rank order of which directions
will appear to compensate, from the checkpoint.
